notes.title: Patch 12-09-2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added high quality lights on/off setting to options. Setting to off will improve performance on low spec hardware. 
[*] Initial setting for lights on/off will be decided by quick, single time benchmark on game start.
[*] New Game option in the start menu. Now it's possible to reset game state without removing save file.
[*] Support for loading saves from demo version.
[/list]
